source.name: A Bola: Benfica revela novo equipamento principal, inspirado na formação
source.quote: A Fly Emirates continua a ser o principal patrocinador, e a Betano o patrocinador secundário.
source.note: Kit-launch coverage of the 2026/27 home shirt. Footy Headlines (https://www.footyheadlines.com/2026/01/new-benfica-26-27-home-kit.html, 8 June 2026): 'All sponsor logos, including Emirates on the chest, are applied in clean, solid white to match the accents.'

source.name: Kaizen Gaming: Betano and SL Benfica renew partnership for 3 more years
source.quote: was the first brand to occupy the sleeve of the official SL Benfica jersey and will remain as the 'Official Betting Sponsor' until the 2026/27 season.
source.note: A Bola's 8 June 2026 kit-launch report: 'A Fly Emirates continua a ser o principal patrocinador, e a Betano o patrocinador secundário.' The club store's photos of the 2026-27 shirt (https://www.slbenfica.pt/pt-pt/loja/equipamentos/principal/adulto/camisola-principal-do-sl-benfica-20262027) show Betano on the sleeve.

source.name: SL Benfica store: Camisola Principal do SL Benfica 2026-2027
source.quote: A Camisola Principal do SL Benfica 2026-2027 é inspirada num dos lugares mais especiais para o Clube, o Benfica Campus.
source.note: The store's back photo of the shirt (https://media.slbenfica.pt/-/media/benficadp/shop/produtos-2020-2021/equipamentos/26-27/principal/adulto/camisola_principal_slbenfica_20262027_2.jpg) shows 'SAGRES' across the upper back. The club's kit-launch page (https://www.slbenfica.pt/en-us/agora/noticias/2026/06/08/clube-benfica-futebol-camisolas-adidas-epoca-2026-27-oficial) lists Sagres among its 'Patrocinadores principais do Futebol'.

source.name: Footy Headlines: Benfica 26-27 Home Kit Released
source.quote: The Adidas Benfica 2026-27 home kit was officially released, featuring a bespoke design with the club's traditional red base and white detailing on the collar, sleeve cuffs, and Three Stripes, built on Adidas's new template with wider shoulder stripes.
source.note: Kit maker, recorded as partner per existing convention.

summary: Emirates on the front, Betano on the sleeve (renewed to 2026/27) and Sagres on the back of the adidas home shirt. Marked complete: the club store's photos of the shirt's front, back and sleeve and of the home shorts (https://www.slbenfica.pt/pt-pt/loja/equipamentos/principal/adulto/camisola-principal-do-sl-benfica-20262027) show no other sponsor.
